parsed_json.up: Select activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units from activities joined to molecule_dictionary on molregno, assays on assay_id, and target_dictionary on tid. Filter where target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', standard_units = 'nM', standard_type in EC50/IC50/AC50, and standard_value < 50. Return distinct rows. Sort by activity_id ascending. Limit 200.
